newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota launches $1.0 bln Euro-Asian bond.
newsitem.headline: Toyota launches $1.0 bln Euro-Asian bond.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp on Tuesday launched a $1.0 billion five-year Euro-Asian bond due July 22, 2002, said one of the joint lead-managers, Merrill Lynch.
The bond will be priced 10 basis points over the yield of U.S. Treasury notes no later than 3 p.m. London time (1400 GMT) on Tuesday, Merrill Lynch said.
The other lead-manager is Credit Suisse First Boston, Merrill Lynch said.
The payment date will be July 22.
The global bond will be listed in London, Hong Kong and Singapore.
